column1: # Level-2 spawn-to-exit chain (issue #28). The full exit chain from the level's own spawn, through
# 1. The spawn-ledge walk takes the data disc (thing 15, sector 109) - `pow_datadisk.cog`
# 2. A warp into sector 622 north of the floor pit, then bryar fire at each linked ReeYee
#    (250, 251, 252, 347 - medium's live four; 249/348 carry the not-medium thingflags). Each
#    from cog 44` at t+8 s; a `--route-trace` run then reports `capture: a script ended the level`,
#    which is the measurement mode holding the world, not a failure).
# 8 shots per ReeYee: the bryar lands roughly half its shots at this range, and the chain only
# needs the four deaths. `wait 700` covers the 8 s sleep (240 ticks) with margin.
